name: duckdb_refresh_views
description:
Reloads the DuckDB sandbox from the data files and reports row counts per table. Each CSV, TSV, Parquet and JSON file in the DuckDB data folder (data.duckdb.dir, default data/duckdb) is a table named after the file (orders.csv is orders), in an in-memory sandbox with no file or URL access; changed files are reloaded automatically.
Returns {refreshed_views, total_refreshed, external_files_reloaded}: each entry is {view_name, status, row_count, refresh_time_ms} or {view_name, status: failed, error_message}.
Inputs: reload_external_files (boolean; default false; true rebuilds every table from the files, false only recounts rows), view_name (one table to report; default all).
Use after adding or changing files when the change is needed before the automatic reload; to see the files duckdb_list_files.
Example: {"reload_external_files": true}

view_name.description: Optional: Specific view to refresh. If not provided, refreshes all views.

refreshed_views.description: List of views that were refreshed

row_count.description: Number of rows in refreshed view

refresh_time_ms.description: Time taken to refresh in milliseconds

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Refresh materialized views and reload external data sources

examples.description: Reload external files and refresh views
